ns2:course.label: Introduction to Poverty
ns2:course.description: Introduction to sociological research about the views, experiences, causes, and consequences of poverty in both advanced and developing countries. One objective is to set the facts straight about who experiences poverty and makes use of the welfare system in the United States. A second purpose is to make sense of the intractable and much more extreme forms of poverty observed across the global South.
